description:
J-Felix presents the Soul drenched VOLUME ONE of his new project, THE MiNT EXPERiMENT. The project came about through going back to the original vibe and tempo of Hip-Hop J-Felix fell in love with whilst growing up in Bristol. The music is built around analogue experimentation, J-Felix's own instrumental performances and genuine brass and string recordings with guest musicians Ben Edwards and Mike Simmonds to give it that authentic feel. Featuring an array of talented guest artists, Victoria Port (Anushka), Bigzy, Bessi, Chloe Bodur and Juga-Naut and of course those fonk flavours the Brighton based producer can't resist... 

Out on OVN Records - J-Felix's own imprint through Republic of Music. 

“Check out the Musician, J-Felix!” – Jamz Supernova (BBC Radio 1Extra)

“A really special producer from Brighton… This record has got such a groove” – Phil Taggart (BBC Radio 1)

“Tru Thoughts came through!”– Erica McKoy (Worldwide FM)

"The track is dope" - DJ Gilla (First Word) 

“So damn good...This guy’s got it going on!” – Huey Morgan (BBC 6Music)

“Excellent... So many reasons to listen to J-Felix’ music” – FIP (Radio France)

“A sublime journey through squelchy electro-funk, tripped-out neo soul and woozy hip-hop beats” – NME

“Producer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, J-Felix seems to embrace the entire universe of funk - from B-Boy hip-hop to neo-soul, vintage R&B to nu-skool vibes” – Clash

“Sounding wonderful!” – Nemone (BBC 6Music)

Recorded, Mixed & Produced by J-Felix (Joe Newman) @ Coachwerks
Mastering: Stephen Kerrison @ Tall Trees Mastering 
Publishing: Full Thought 
Distribution: Republic Of Music
credits:
Keys, Guitar, Synths, bass, Beats, Percussion, BV's & Production: J-Felix

Violin & Viola: Mike Simmonds 

Trumpet & Flugelhorn - Ben Edwards 

Bass & extra synths on 'The Love that Hurts' - Bessi

Vocals & Lyrics: Juga-Naut, Bessi, Bigzy, Chloe Bodur, J-Felix & Jerry Clavier (aka Sol Goodman)
